items.title: Cisco gives engineer unlimited AI tokens to rewrite legacy code
items.summary: Meet Paddy, the 27-year-old Cisco’s president calls an “energizer bunny.” He’s been given unlimited AI tokens and told to “go nuts.”
items.titleZh: 思科向工程师提供无限量 AI 令牌，让其重写遗留代码
items.summaryZh: 认识一下帕迪，这位 27 岁的年轻人被思科总裁称为“精力充沛的小马达”。他获准无限使用 AI 令牌，并被告知“放手去做”。

items.title: The $6.3B Binance hack was pulled off in just 20 minutes
items.summary: Multiple crypto-tracing firms say notorious North Korean hackers TraderTraitor may be behind the largest digital heist in history—with billions of crypto likely gone for good.
items.titleZh: 价值 63 亿美元的 Binance 黑客攻击仅用 20 分钟便得手
items.summaryZh: 多家加密货币追踪公司表示，臭名昭著的朝鲜黑客组织 TraderTraitor 可能是史上最大数字资产劫案的幕后黑手，数十亿美元的加密货币恐怕已永久损失。

items.title: Through Captain Jean-Luc Picard, Patrick Stewart taught us the measure of a man
items.summary: Patrick Stewart's most famous character showed a generation of youth a complex character who strived to do what was right.
items.titleZh: 通过让·吕克·皮卡德舰长，帕特里克·斯图尔特教会我们何谓真正的人
items.summaryZh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特最著名的角色向一代年轻人展现了一个复杂的人物：他努力做正确的事。

items.summary: So today I reached a nice milestone in one of my projects: my work porting classic Mac OS to PowerPC systems with what I affectionately call ArtX chipsets (Nintendo GameCube, Wii, eventually Wii U; the GameCube’s Flipper…
items.titleZh: 我最喜欢的 PowerMac 是任天堂 Wii
items.summaryZh: 今天，我的一个项目达成了一个值得庆祝的里程碑：我将经典 Mac OS 移植到 PowerPC 系统上，这些系统采用我亲切称为 ArtX 芯片组的硬件（任天堂 GameCube、Wii，最终还有 Wii U；GameCube 的 Flipper……）

items.title: The federated code forge
items.summary: For most of the past two decades, the code forge has been where projects live: where code is hosted, where changes are reviewed, and where contributors find each other. Forges offered convenience in exchange for centrali…

items.summaryZh: 过去二十多年里，代码托管平台一直是项目的家园：代码在这里托管，改动在这里审查，贡献者在这里相识。平台以便利换取中心化……

items.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
items.summary: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.
items.titleZh: 英伟达考虑为 Nscale 在西弗吉尼亚州的 AI 数据中心贷款担任共同签署人
items.summaryZh: 投资者对 AI 开支感到不安时，如果卖芯片的芯片制造商愿意为贷款共同签署，就能起到帮助。

items.title: Salesforce’s M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune
items.summary: The AI logistics startup will bolster the CRM giant's Missionforce defense platform.
items.titleZh: Salesforce 并购热潮继续，据报以 3.75 亿美元收购国防科技初创公司 Rune
items.summaryZh: 这家 AI 物流初创公司将助力这家 CRM 巨头强化其 Missionforce 国防平台。

items.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
items.titleZh: 注重隐私的 AI 助手 Ollie 即将停止运营
items.summaryZh: 随着越来越多 AI 助手涌入市场，Ollie 的创始人表示，这款尊重用户隐私的助手将在一周后停止运营。

items.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
items.summary: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.
items.titleZh: 英特尔股价暴跌，政府持股价值缩水 120 亿美元
items.summaryZh: AI 行业大量消耗内存及其他零部件，推高了电脑价格；电脑销售疲软也令英特尔受挫。

items.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
items.summary: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its busin…
items.titleZh: 《金融时报》报道称，Anthropic IPO 后预计将获信用评级机构较低的“垃圾级”评级
items.summaryZh: 贝莱德的预测终究只是预测，但如果 Anthropic 获得较低的垃圾级评级，筹集资金将更加困难、成本也会更高，而这些资金对维持其支撑业务发展的巨额支出至关重要。

items.title: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
items.summary: No Halloween costume? Just be a deceptively cute AI agent icon, a PHP vulnerability, or sleepy time Bryan Johnson.
items.titleZh: 科技迷的万圣节最后一刻装扮点子
items.summaryZh: 还没准备万圣节装扮？不妨扮成看似可爱的 AI 智能体图标、一个 PHP 漏洞，或睡眼惺忪的布莱恩·约翰逊。

items.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
items.summary: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.
items.titleZh: AI 支出热潮开始出现裂痕
items.summaryZh: 大型科技公司正向 AI 基础设施投入数十亿美元，但债务增加、现金流为负以及投资者日益增长的怀疑，正让人们开始质疑这波 AI 支出热潮能否持续。

items.title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
items.summary: Like a real-life episode of "Suits," the demise of famed white-shoe Wall Street law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges has been the talk of the legal industry. And now an AI firm has entered the picture.
items.titleZh: AI 律所 Crosby 出价竞购濒临瓦解的知名律所 Weil Gotshal
items.summaryZh: 就像现实版《金装律师》一样，华尔街知名顶级律所 Weil, Gotshal & Manges 的衰落已成为法律界热议的话题。如今，一家 AI 公司也加入了这场风波。
